scope: Pre-AC1021 DXF DIMSTYLE DIMFXL group-49 output

evidence.format_crosswalk: The implementation's DIMSTYLE variable descriptor maps group 49 to DIMFXL with minimum revision AC1021. Autodesk identifies DIMFXL as a new AutoCAD 2007 system variable and documents its initial value as 1.0. Autodesk's AutoCAD 2007 DIMSTYLE group-code table does not list group 49; ezdxf documents DIMFXL group 49 as an unofficial R2007+ DIMSTYLE variable.

references.title: Autodesk: New system variables in AutoCAD 2007
Autodesk AutoCAD 2007 DXF Reference
references.observation: Group 49 is not listed in the DIMSTYLE table.

references.title: ezdxf DIMSTYLE internals
references.observation: Records DIMFXL group 49 as an unofficial R2007+ variable; peer documentation, not Autodesk authority.

evidence.code: dxfRW::writeDimstyle no longer emits its DIMFXL default group 49 before AC1021. Before that revision, a nondefault typed dimfxl value or nondefault dynamic group-49 override fails before record output.
evidence.control: libdxfrw_dimstyle_table_allocation verifies that ASCII AC1014/AC1018 output contains no DIMSTYLE group 49, checks atomic refusal and same-writer retry for typed and dynamic nondefault values in ASCII/Binary, and retains the existing seven-revision allocation rollback/retry matrix.
evidence.fixture_policy: Generated controls write only to the system temporary directory; no DWG or DXF fixture added to the repository.
limits: The Autodesk 2007 schema does not list DIMFXL group 49; the mapping and revision threshold are additionally corroborated by the existing implementation crosswalk and ezdxf, not an explicit Autodesk group-code entry.
This does not qualify other unofficial DIMSTYLE variables or native AutoCAD/LibreCAD rendering semantics.
